scripts.test:ios: APPIUM_TARGET=local APPIUM_PLATFORM=ios LOCAL_IOS_SIMULATOR_UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices | grep "(Booted)" | grep -E -o -i "([0-9a-f]{8}-([0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12})") yarn run jest --runInBand
scripts.test:ios:smoke: APPIUM_TARGET=local APPIUM_PLATFORM=ios LOCAL_IOS_SIMULATOR_UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices | grep "(Booted)" | grep -E -o -i "([0-9a-f]{8}-([0-9a-f]{4}-){3}[0-9a-f]{12})") yarn run jest --testPathPattern=/smoke/ --runInBand
